items.label: 【Suitable for Indoor & Outdoor Use】

items.label: 【Versatile Gardening Solution】
items.value: Plant support is suitable for climbing plants like vegetables and ivy, and also compatible with a wide range of flowers, helping you create stunning garden scenes in any setting

items.label: 【Tool-Free Quick Assembly】
items.value: No tools are needed for assembly—simply snap the pieces together for a sturdy support structure within minutes, and take it apart just as easily for space-saving storage
